title: 第三章 收服猪婆龙第四章 安身立命之本
content_zh:
就这？
八十文就这么到手了？渔民一天的工作量？
梁渠神色振奋，如此简单就获得了八十文钱，实在让人欲罢不能。
不过确实累，控制完三十斤力量的水流，跟跑完一千米似的，肚子又开始咕咕叫。
融合泽灵后，他的身体素质有些许提升，但毕竟底子太薄，依旧羸弱。
趁着夜色还深，梁渠决定休息一下，再试一次。
陈叔八十文过得拮据，是因为他有孩子，家中还有老人要赡养，梁渠无牵无挂，这收入绝对不少，且看今晚能不能梅开二度。
半个时辰后，梁渠再度入水。
依仗水猴子天赋，在水中他的体力消耗极少，游出一百米，几乎和走两三百米消耗的气力相当。
闭气时间也延长到大七分钟，这可不是静滞，而是移动中的七分钟，称得上是惊为天人。
可惜抓黄鱼似乎用光了运气，一连换过四五次气，游荡有小半个时辰，梁渠只在中途看到一条价值在百文左右的花斑鱼。
花斑鱼价值没有黄鱼高，值一百文是它体格够大，足有十斤。
一斤鱼十斤力，十斤重的大鱼，猛然爆发下足有近百斤的气力。
以梁渠现在的状态，加上只有三十斤的控水能力，对付它还真挺吃力，只能眼睁睁看对方游走。
“看来下次可以带把长矛，这样就能对付体型比较大的鱼，不过死鱼价格没有活鱼高啊，渔网我也没有......”
梁渠在水中思索之际，不知不觉游得远了，竟来到一处较浅处的水底滩，不过说是浅，也有十数米之深。
“咦，居然有藕？”
踏足水底，梁渠的感知中突然出现了植物的茎块，靠近后仔细一辨认，发现居然是莲藕。
水深十多米的地方还能有藕？
梁渠大感惊奇。

不管是浮水，挺水，还是沉水植物，它们的生长都离不开光合和呼吸，水越深越不利于这两个过程。
莲藕就属于对光照和呼吸要求比较高的植物，就梁渠所知，一般超过两米水深莲藕就活不下去。
意识到莲藕生长环境的反常，梁渠却是兴奋起来。
植物离不开光合作用和呼吸，但那是对于普通植物而言，对于一些宝植，自然不在此列。
这个世界可是有着超凡力量的！
眼下这藕能长这么深，定然不凡，听说隔壁镇子的赵老爷有口寒潭，深数十米，底下还长着角菱，吃了能延年益寿，靠此笼络了两名武者，不知真假。
自己居然也碰上了？
梁渠当即顺着莲藕的生长脉络游动，一查看发现这莲藕还真不小，十几米还没找到头，正当他想要继续游动时，一个模糊的大东西突然出现在他的感知之中。
什么东西？
好大一只！
梁渠迅速停下拉开距离。
对方并无反应，似乎没有发现他？
面对可能是宝植的莲藕，梁渠犹豫了一下，没有选择离开，而是小心翼翼地绕着圈，进行水中感知。
对方就埋伏在淤泥中，很长，足有两米，但不是鱼，有四肢，尾巴很长，体型纤细......
三米外他能感受到的轮廓十分模糊，可这形象太鲜明了，梁渠瞪大了眼。
是猪婆龙！
猪婆龙是俗称，用大白话讲就是鳄鱼，只不过猪婆龙是渔民对所有鳄鱼的统称，江淮河里有不止一种鳄鱼，梁渠不知道淤泥底下的是什么品种。
附近一带，最常见的应该是太华鳄吧？
原身见过太华鳄，梁渠感觉和前世的扬子鳄差不多，体型不大，成年也就两米，体重三十多公斤。
这个体型对成年人来说其实不算什么，体重是致命伤，但那是在陆地，现在是在水下，尤其梁渠还只是一个营养不良的少年，体重大也大不了多少。

况且......
“这太华鳄就卧伏在莲藕旁边，不会是知道这莲藕对它有好处吧？”
content_en:
That's it?
Is this how you got eighty cents? How much work does a fisherman do in a day?
Liang Qu looked excited. It was really tempting to get eighty coins so easily.
But I was really tired. After controlling the water flow of thirty kilograms, it was like running a thousand meters, and my stomach began to growl again.
After merging with Zeling, his physical fitness improved slightly, but after all, his foundation was too weak and he was still weak.
While the night was still dark, Liang Qu decided to take a rest and try again.
Uncle Chen's 80-cent life is in straitened circumstances because he has children and elderly people at home to support. Liang Qu has nothing to worry about. This income is definitely a lot. Let's see if he can score twice tonight.
Half an hour later, Liang Qu entered the water again.
Relying on his talent as a water monkey, he consumes very little physical energy in the water. Swimming a hundred meters is almost the same as walking two to three hundred meters.
The breath-holding time has also been extended to seven minutes. This is not a stasis, but seven minutes of movement, which is truly astonishing.
Unfortunately, he seemed to have run out of luck in catching yellow croaker. He changed his energy four or five times in a row and wandered for half an hour. Liang Qu only saw a grouper fish worth about a hundred yuan in the middle.
The value of the piebald fish is not as high as that of the yellow croaker. It is worth a hundred cents because it is big enough, weighing ten kilograms.
One pound of fish has the power of ten pounds, and a big fish weighing ten pounds can exert nearly a hundred pounds of force in a sudden burst.
In Liang Qu's current state, and with the ability to control water of only thirty kilograms, it was really difficult to deal with it, and I could only watch the opponent swim away.
"It seems that I can bring a spear next time so that I can deal with larger fish, but the price of dead fish is not as high as that of live fish, and I don't have a fishing net..."
While Liang Qu was thinking about it in the water, he swam far away without realizing it, and came to a shallower underwater beach. It was only shallow, but it was still more than ten meters deep.
"Hey, there are lotus roots?"
Stepping under the water, Liang Qu's perception suddenly appeared a plant stem. When he got closer, he carefully identified it and found that it was actually a lotus root.
Can there be lotus roots in a place with a water depth of more than ten meters?
Liang Qu was surprised.
Whether they are floating, emergent, or submerged plants, their growth is inseparable from photosynthesis and respiration. The deeper the water, the less conducive it is to these two processes.
Lotus roots are plants that have relatively high requirements for light and respiration. As far as Liang Qu knows, lotus roots generally cannot survive if the water depth exceeds two meters.
Realizing the abnormal growth environment of lotus roots, Liang Qu became excited.
Plants are inseparable from photosynthesis and respiration, but that is for ordinary plants, and for some precious plants, this is naturally not included.
This world has extraordinary power!
Now that the lotus root can grow so deep, it must be extraordinary. I heard that Mr. Zhao in the next town has a cold lake, which is tens of meters deep. There are also horn water chestnuts growing at the bottom. Eating it can extend your life. I don't know whether it is true or not.
Did you actually run into it yourself?
Liang Qu immediately swam along the growth veins of the lotus root. Upon inspection, he found that the lotus root was really not small. He could not find the end of the lotus root after more than ten meters. Just when he wanted to continue swimming, a large and vague thing suddenly appeared in his perception.
What?
What a big one!
Liang Qu quickly stopped and distanced himself.
The other party didn't respond and didn't seem to notice him?
Facing the lotus root that might be Baozhi, Liang Qu hesitated for a moment and did not choose to leave. Instead, he circled carefully to sense the water.
The opponent was lurking in the mud. It was very long, up to two meters long, but it was not a fish. It had four limbs, a long tail, and a slender body...
The outline he could feel three meters away was very blurry, but the image was so vivid that Liang Qu's eyes widened.
It's a pig dragon!
Zhupolong is a common name. In the vernacular, it is a crocodile. However, Zhupolong is the collective name for all crocodiles by fishermen. There are more than one kind of crocodile in the Jianghuai River. Liang Qu doesn’t know what species is under the mud.
In the nearby area, the most common one should be the Taihua crocodile, right?
Liang Qu originally met Taihua Crocodile, and Liang Qu felt that he was the same as his predecessor.The alligators in the world are similar in size. They are only two meters long in adulthood and weigh more than 30 kilograms.
This size is actually nothing to an adult. Weight is a fatal injury, but that was on land, and now he is underwater, especially when Liang Qu is just a malnourished teenager, and his weight is not much greater.
Besides...
"This Taihua Crocodile is lying next to the lotus root. Does it know that the lotus root is good for it?"
